story hit 1 high-risk signal(s): Validation Framework. Recommend stricter review standards (>= 3 preMortem scenarios, explicit rollback path). If this story only mentions rather than modifies that area (false positive), run lattice story_review_dismiss '{"storyId":"B-4254","category":"<category>","reason":"..."}' to fully roll back the auto-elevation (after all auto-elevated riskSignals are dismissed, priority auto-reverts and high-risk gates are lifted).
High-risk story must fill decision.json (principles/drivers/options/chosen/>= 3 preMortem). Call: lattice decision_set '{...}'
